column1: # Which values of config.json are accepted, checked by the Rust core (policy/config_file.rs) and by C++ Test 45
# through vf_rust_config_load. Each row is read as a file holding only that key: {"key": value}, or
# {"memory": {"key": value}} for the memory keys, or {"custom_game_exes": [value]} for game_exe.
# Row: id <TAB> key <TAB> value as JSON text <TAB> accepted|rejected.
# Ranges (factory value in brackets): poll_interval_ms 250..60000 [1500], timer_resolution_ns100 5000..156250
# max_game_disk_read_mb_s 1..100000 [15]. They keep the daemon working; they are not tuning advice.
